Install: download the `.pbw` below and open it with the Pebble app. Works on Pebble Time 2 and Pebble Round 2.

**Image credits** (full list and licences in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/hornofabraxas/parallax-weather/blob/main/CREDITS.md)):

- Partly cloudy texture adapted from [Clouds and blue sky in Russia](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Clouds_and_blue_sky_in_Russia._IMG_110.jpg) by Dmitry Makeev, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
- Cloudy texture adapted from [Altocumulus clouds (mackerel sky)](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Altocumulus_clouds_(mackerel_sky)_(late_afternoon,_10_June_2015)_(Virginia,_Minnesota,_USA)_3_(22859440393).jpg) by James St. John, [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/)
- Rain texture adapted from [Raindrops on the glass](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Raindrops_on_the_glass.jpg) by BogTar201213, [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
- Sun (NASA/SDO), storm (NOAA) and moon (NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio): public domain
- Digits: Inter Display Black, SIL Open Font License 1.1

The adapted textures were cropped, tone-mapped and dithered to the Pebble palette.
